annotations.text:
PARCEL Fund — fractional real-estate token marketplace
Muted sage-teal #79C2A8, used sparingly: primary buttons, active tabs and presets, selected nav, progress fills, status dots. Everything else — numbers, icons, charts, building art, tags — is a neutral grey ramp on near-black, so the accent reads as emphasis rather than wallpaper. Glass panels, soft shadows, no hard glow. Space Grotesk display, IBM Plex Mono on every number.

Everything is clickable: filter tabs, quick-buy presets, the token slider, tab switching, watchlists, claim rent.

All prices, yields, addresses and sponsor names are sample data for feeling out the flow — swap them before this goes anywhere real. The Reg D / 12-month lockup line on the buy panel is a placeholder too: your counsel decides the actual offering language.
